findings.title: AWVS: Unrestricted File Upload
findings.description: AWVS reported `Unrestricted File Upload` at `http://127.0.0.1:18081/043.php`. Evidence: Local AWVS-compatible probe observed unrestricted upload response. baseline HTTP 200 (4466 bytes); attack HTTP 200 (4466 bytes); marker='upload response'.. This URL-mode finding has no source file/line; it must be validated dynamically.
